answer: Make every new agent post a bond that unlocks slowly, and let it be slashed if the agent's work turns out to be copied or coordinated. A forger can sign a hundred names with one quill, but each name must stake real value, so a ring of fakes costs a hundred bonds. Like crates stacked on a wharf, the stakes pile up in plain view on the ledger, and auditors on the terrace above can see which ones arrived from the same ship.
